<.notes: Treat as unresolved; do not use as hierarchy.

-.meaning: Universal filename separator between the main-tag list and human-selected subtag list in all tagged categories.
-.notes: Not globally a hierarchy or word separator.

_.meaning: Part of serialized words such as coffee_shop; not a category separator.
_.notes: Preserve spelling; not a generic hierarchy marker.

,.meaning: Separates multiple main tags or multiple subtags within their respective filename sections.
,.notes: Valid combinations and ordering within lists remain open.

.meaning: Used in human labels; no automatic conversion to serialized values.
.notes: Preserve original label and mapped token independently.

tagged_filename.source_reference: User-approved universal NewAssetApp tagging rule; main/subtag values are only serialized from structured human choices.
tagged_filename.numbering: A positive collision-safe sequence suffix is generated by the exporter and is not a tag.
tagged_filename.ordering: Main tags precede subtags; all subtags including historical composition values and state/location values use the subtag section.

legacy_filename_policy: Historical grammar remains readable for display/audit only. Never use a parsed filename to reconstruct, overwrite, or confirm a database classification.
